meta.name: onboarding
meta.description: Guides a first-time omo user through setup and the core workflow. Use when a new user asks to get started with omo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 跟着引导完成首次配置,顺畅跑通核心工作流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚接触这个工具,想快速知道从哪一步开始。
copy.tagline_en: Walk through first-time setup and get the core workflow running
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're new to this tool and unsure where to begin.

howto.what: 第一次使用时它会自我介绍,并带你按顺序走六条线:功能介绍、迁移旧的编码代理配置、翻看你以前的会话、估算缓存省下的钱、随时记下你的偏好,以及提出 init-deep 建议。
howto.when: 当第一次使用 omo 的用户提出想上手 omo 时,自动触发一次。之后可用 omo --onboard 或 senpi --onboard 手动唤回这次引导。

say.text: 我是第一次用 omo,带我上手一遍
帮我把我以前的 Claude Code 配置迁移过来
say.note: 先给你看迁移计划,你同意才动手

say.text: 看看我以前那些会话,估一下能省多少缓存钱
say.note: 只对 Senpi 会话算这笔钱

howto.what_en: On a first run it introduces itself and walks you through six lanes in order: a feature tour, migration of your old agent config, digging through past sessions, cache-savings estimates, memory notes, and an init-deep proposal.
howto.when_en: It triggers automatically once, when a new omo user asks to get started with omo. The tour can be brought back later with the `omo --onboard` or `senpi --onboard` flag.

say_en.text: I'm new to omo, walk me through getting started
Migrate my old Claude Code setup over
say_en.note: Shows a plan first, waits for your yes

say_en.text: Look at my past sessions and estimate cache savings
